title: Treatment system.
officialText:
The exhaust ventilation from gas cabinets, exhausted enclosures and gas rooms, and local exhaust
systems required in Sections 502.9.8.2 and 502.9.8.3 shall be directed to a treatment system where required by the New York City
Fire Code.
